title: Ahtna - Wikipedia
text: The Ahtna (also Ahtena, Atna, Ahtna-kohtaene, or Copper River) are an Alaska Native Athabaskan people of the Athabaskan-speaking ethnolinguistic group.

title: Ahtena Language (AHT) – L1 & L2 Speakers... | Ethnologue Free
text: Ahtena is an endangered indigenous language of the United States. It belongs to the Eyak-Athabaskan language family. The language is used as a first language by older adults only.
